transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been feeling worn down almost all the time, even when I get a full night’s sleep. By the time I’ve dealt with work and the clutter around the house, I don’t really have much energy left for anything else.
Alongside feeling worn down, have you also been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless?

Yeah, most days I have this sort of low, gray feeling in the background. I can still go to the lab and talk to people, but I don’t really feel light or excited about things I used to enjoy, like baking or checking the telescope.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
It started shortly after we moved into the older house, so… a little over two years now.
During these past two years, have you had any periods lasting more than two months where you felt like your usual self again?
No, I don’t think so. It’s been pretty consistently low since we moved into the old house—just over two years now.
During these past two years, has this low feeling stayed at roughly the same level, or have there been times when it became significantly more severe?
It’s stayed pretty much at the same low level. Most days it’s just this gray feeling in the background—I can still function, but I don’t feel much excitement about the things I used to enjoy.
